notes.title: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos Release Coming November 4!
notes.content:
[h3]Release date confirmed: November 4, 2025 🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]Hi everyone!
We’ve got some exciting news: [i]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/i] will officially launch on [b]November 4, 2025[/b]. Mark your calendars, because chaos is coming![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QiVZsfM92do;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔨 What we’ve been working on[/h2][p]Over the past months, our small indie team has been polishing the game and making sure the cleaning chaos feels as fun (and unpredictable!) as possible. Here’s a peek:[/p][list][*][p][b]New tools[/b] – from vacuums to… “less conventional” devices 🤪[/p][/*][*][p][b]Physics tweaks[/b] – smoother chaos, funnier fails, better co-op experience[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cats[/b] – yes, even more cats, and they’re cheekier than ever 🐱[/p][/*][*][p][b]Levels[/b] – new environments to test your teamwork… or destroy it[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Why “Cleaning Chaos”?[/h2][p]We always wanted to make a co-op game that mixes [b]teamwork and trolling[/b]. You [i]can[/i] try to clean properly, but it’s just as much fun to knock over your friend’s bucket, ride a vacuum, or let a cat steal your tools. It’s that mix of order and disaster that makes every session unpredictable.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]👀 What’s next?[/h2][list][*][p][b]Playtests are open sign up now[/b]! Your feedback helps us a ton.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist on Steam to get notified on launch day:[/b]
 [/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers_Cleaning_Chaos/"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p]More sneak peeks coming in future devlogs – including behind-the-scenes looks at level design, cat AI, and chaos physics.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Join the chaos[/h2][p]We’d love to hear from you![/p][list][*][p]Are you [b]Team Clean[/b] 🧽 or [b]Team Chaos[/b] 💥?[/p][/*][*][p]Which cat behavior would you love to see in the game?[/p][/*][/list][p]Drop a comment, share your ideas, and get ready for November 4![/p][p]Thanks for supporting us – you’re the reason we can keep making silly, chaotic games like this. ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]— The [i]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/i] dev team[/p]

notes.title: First thoughts after your feedback!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players!
or should I say Dear Purrrifiers?

We would like to thank you for all of your feedback. It's very important for us to understand how you feel with the game. We gathered over 3.000 answers and guest what... we read every single one of them!

We also watched many youtubers and streamers who were playing our game and OMG it was hilarious to watch. There is CHAOS! But the most precious thing was to see you players smiling and laughing during the game.

[b]We received many positive messages which put a smile on our faces:
[/b][list]
[*]"I found this game through KYRSpeedy on YouTube, and decided to try it myself. I had a lot of fun, and I think this game is a really cool concept. I like that it's not just one kind of cleaning, and I would love to play it with my friends. Also, I did kill Annabelle on accident, and I love that you actually made the unicorns do different things. Devs, I think that you've done a great job taking a popular genre (satisfying cleaning games) and made it unique. Love the cat, and being able to throw away the family's wine collection was funny to me. Keep up the great work, and I can't wait to see what the rest of the game looks like! (some lore, hopefully. who has lasers in their house?)"
[*]"I will buy everything from this game, it is currently (I am broke) the free version of powerwash but also somehow the gameplay is amazing so I want to grind to get the money to buy it"
[*]"As someone who finds the cleaning sim games enjoyable, that aspect was fantastic! I also enjoyed the extra things to do. Like the summoning and being able to feed the trash to Mr. Hole! Makes the game even more enjoyable!"
[*]"Your game has the potential to be the best in its genre, congratulations to the whole team for your work ! I can't wait to play it in full versions !"
[*]"I am STOKED for this game! I cannot wait to see the full version, you guys rock!!!  The kitty cat elements are super fun as well. Just love the whole thing and cannot wait!!!"
[/list]

[b]There were also some creepy/weird answers (or maybe confessions):
[/b]
[list]
[*]"One time I tried to stick a finger up my bum in the shower but it hurt so I applied some soap and managed to get it in but it still hurt and didnt feel nice so I wont be doing that again"
[*]"developer pls stop makeing games thank you very much"
[*]"my name is amanda"
[*]"Pennsylvania lisence plate only go on the rear bumber not the front bumper"
[*]"my nipples are a weird colour of brown"
[/list]

but hey, we don't judge. Every piece feedback is precious :P

We have a plan and we have a ton of ideas for this game. Every two weeks we will share something more with you, but don't worry there will be no big spoilers :)
Our main goal is to delivery Early Access version as soon as possible and also we will prepare update to our free demo.

Yes, we will improve the faucet/tap in the kitchen. Here is our big brain fix :P

BEFORE:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/189bfc2e174e223544b8c246d2e7c09c21e90306.png[/img]

AFTER:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/7768ad3891379a21109a31bbc4152f5c9da03ca2.png[/img]

Just kidding, we will improve this task in other way ;)

So stay tuned to receive more information from the game. There is also something special incoming for you very soon :P

notes.title: New demo release date
notes.content:
Hello Purrrifiers,

[h2]You are probably waiting to play our demo, which should have been up and running on the launch of Steam Next Fest. We are sorry that wasn't possible, as we found some bugs in the final build and needed to postpone it.[/h2]

[h3][b]We have set a final date for the demo release which is the [b]8th of November[/b].[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235870/Purrrifiers_Cleaning_Chaos_Demo/

We have been silent as we couldn't estimate how long it will take to us to thoroughly fix everything, and we want the best experience possible for you.

Thank you for support,
Rubens Games team.

notes.title: We Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello Purrrifers!

[h3]Today [u]we[/u] want to [u]reveal[/u] a bit more about the game. Here we will share some key stuff you'll find in [b]Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos[/b].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/a88b6e73c7094ff3715fb4d562b0f036e8a128c3.png[/img]

[u][h3][b]CORE OF THE GAME:[/b][/h3][/u]

[b]Single Player[/b] - Experience the game in a solo mode where you can tackle challenges on your own.

[b]Online Co-op[/b] - Team up with friends online to clean and solve puzzles together in cooperative multiplayer mode.

[b]Story[/b] - Immerse yourself in a story-driven experience filled with quirky characters and unexpected twists.
